properties.name: llmrix.model.router.http.enabled
properties.description: Enables the OpenAI-compatible HTTP and SSE endpoints.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.http.auth.mode
properties.description: HTTP authentication mode: api-key or none.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.http.auth.bootstrap-key
properties.description: Bootstrap Bearer key used by the default HTTP verifier.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.state.local.max-quota-partitions
properties.description: Maximum number of in-process quota partitions. New partitions are rejected when full.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.state.local.quota-idle-timeout
properties.description: Idle time before an in-process quota partition can expire.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.routes.*.strategy
properties.description: Routing strategy ID for this route.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.routes.*.models
properties.description: Ordered model references available to this route.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.routes.*.quota.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Optional shared requests-per-minute quota for this route.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.routes.*.quota.tokens-per-minute
properties.description: Optional shared tokens-per-minute quota for this route.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.routes.*.models[].integration
properties.description: Integration ID containing the routed model.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.routes.*.models[].model
properties.description: Model name within the integration.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.provider
properties.description: Model provider component ID.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.base-url
properties.description: Provider API base URL shared by all models in the integration.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.api-key
properties.description: Provider credential passed to the configured authenticator.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.authenticator
properties.description: ProviderAuthenticator component ID.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.forward-routing-hints
properties.description: Forwards the private routing-hints header to the provider. Disabled by default.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.models
properties.description: Models exposed by this provider integration. Each item must define a unique name.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.models[].name
properties.description: Provider model name.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.models[].operations
properties.description: Callable operations exposed by the provider model, such as chat, embeddings, or rerank.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.models[].features
properties.description: Protocol features exposed by the model, such as streaming, tools, structured-output, or prompt-cache.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.models[].input-modalities
properties.description: Non-text input modalities accepted by the model: vision, audio, video, or file.

properties.name: llmrix.model.router.integrations.*.models[].traits
properties.description: Model traits used for routing, such as code, reasoning, or long-context.
